scope: The standing Beaverbrook Art Gallery on Queen Street, including the surviving historic galleries, 2017 east pavilion and 2022 Harrison McCain entrance pavilion.

originalReview.notes: Exact exterior photograph establishes the original stone and light fascia bands, alongside tall narrow original entry lights. Excludes artworks and vehicles.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact Qualla photograph of the original gallery, directly dedicated to the public domain by its photographer. Modern pavilion appearance uses the written architectural record and current mapped footprint.
